verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents its own 'Track use and activity' capability for admins and advanced reporting via BigQuery on higher tiers, so organization-level usage reporting exists. However, none of the evidence shows the specific metrics or breakdowns the story asks for. missing for 10: documented call volume, answer rate and missed-call metrics, per-number and per-teammate breakdowns, a support-leader dashboard view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate

citations.quote: Track use and activity—Understand how your organization uses Voice.
